name.value: Bayani, a friendly eagle wearing glasses and a woven hat. Bayani — BAYA’s illustrated learning companion. OUR LEARNING JOURNEY / 01 Meet BAYA! Your Baybayin Learning Adventure Begins Here Mabuhay! Welcome to BAYA! Are you ready to discover Baybayin? Meet Bayani, your friendly learning companion! Curious and cheerful, Bayani joins you through lessons, writing activities, and new discoveries. Together, you will explore Baybayin characters, practice writing, and learn about our Filipino heritage. Come along—our learning adventure is about to begin!
